text:
maria-partners: FYI partners escalated yesterday about an OCI marketplace publish failure. it hit general support and was triaged slowly. we should formalize partner escalation lanes (marketplace, SI, hardware).
zane-eng: agreed. proposal: dedicated partner PD service + partner-shared war room channels. partner PD gets immediate page for marketplace publish or entitlement failures.
leah-se: for SI integrations (webhooks/auth) we need a short checklist partners can run before paging: token refresh, webhook replay, callback URL health. saves both sides time.
diego-sre: suggest severity definitions scoped to partners:
- partner-sev1: production impact to >=10 paying customers or cross-customer publish outage
- partner-sev2: single-customer outage or publish blocked for a partner
- partner-sev3: listing/metadata issues with no immediate customer impact
kevin-ops: I'll map those into PagerDuty. sample rule: if alert.source == "marketplace" and alert.metric == "publish.failure.rate" and rate > 3/min -> route: partner-pd (sev2->partner-pd; sev1 adds sre-pd).
marketplace-bot: TIP: use /partner-contact <provider> to pull provider ops contacts for AWS/GCP/Azure.
maria-partners: we also need a simple partner-facing one-pager: who to contact (slack + PD id), expected ack times, and whether war room will be public.
zane-eng: on public vs private war rooms: default to partner-facing unless customer requests privacy. include RACI: partner-liaison posts partner updates; eng lead posts technical updates; SRE posts status/resolution.
leah-se: internal SLA targets proposed: ack within 10m for partner-sev1, 20m for partner-sev2. mark these as internal targets (not contractual).
diego-sre: SRE will commit to 10m ack for partner-sev1 when PD pages. we'll add an automated runbook link in the war room description: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/partner-escalation. also adding postmortem template requiring partner impact timeline.
kevin-ops: operational changes I'll make: PD escalation maps + alertmanager filters + war room creation template. snippet to add to ops repo:

```yaml
partner_escalation:
  sev1: pages: [sre-pd, partner-se-pd, eng-pd]
  sev2: pages: [partner-se-pd, eng-pd]
  sev3: notify: [partners-channel]
```

oncall-bot: NOTICE: new rotation applied. Next primary oncall: diego-sre until 2026-04-11 07:00 UTC.
maria-partners: one more ask: bizdev must be looped before any public partner announcement. add that as a pre-publish check in the runbook.
zane-eng: i'll prepare a minimal war room dashboard template (errors, publish queue depth, auth failures) that can be copied into any partner war room.
leah-se: i'll draft the partner one-pager and sample outreach email telling partners where to escalate and what to expect.
diego-sre: i'll create the war room template and postmortem checklist. kevin, ping when PD changes merged and i'll test routing.
kevin-ops: PR coming in: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/pd/pulls/105. will notify when deployed.
maria-partners: great. goal: have partner escalation playbook live and linked from partner onboarding before next release. syncing Tue 9am PT to finalize. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
